limitations: Development artifact consistency audit, rerunning the same scorer rather than independently implementing metric formulas.
Exact model file hashes are verified, but file inequality does not prove semantic model independence or global temporal isolation.
Full DEV gold is not persisted: audit trusts frozen pool gold/membership and cannot independently reconstruct the complete correct pool or full-DEV accuracy.
Event hashes verify internal consistency, not externally anchored completeness or actual execution honesty.
Target caches are checked for ID alignment and legal labels, not regenerated through model inference.
Timing fields are measured stage wall times, not deployment cost savings or a hard training timeout.
